citation.title: Are There Clinical Differences Between 3D-Printed and Milled Complete Dentures? A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
citation.authors: Erfan Khorasani, Aida Mokhlesi, Sarah Arzani, Safoura Ghodsi, Seyed Ali Mosaddad

s_design.anchor: SR/meta-analysis of RCTs and non-randomized clinical studies (THERAPY SR/MA row, 100, via Step 2 routing)

domains.evidence_quote: PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, Embase, Cochrane
domains.note: five bibliographic databases plus Google Scholar and reference-list screening; English-language restriction noted but no 3b-i threshold applies

domains.evidence_quote: excluded (k = 0.93). 47,75,76 The study by Chaturvedi et al. 75
domains.note: all three excluded full-text studies are named by reference number, each with its own reason (occlusal parameters, fabrication accuracy, intaglio trueness)

domains.domain: risk of bias assessment of included studies
domains.evidence_quote: the Cochrane RoB 2 and ROBINS-I tools

domains.note: methods as described: SMD, random effects, Q/I2/tau2, subgroup and leave-one-out analyses. The pooling of several intervention-comparison pairs from one study as independent data points is recorded once, as the unit-of-analysis critical flaw in 3c, not here: 'treated as a separate data point in the meta-analysis' (3 articles = 8 pairs for retention, 2 articles = 4 pairs for satisfaction), with no adjustment for non-independence anywhere in the text

domains.evidence_quote: publication bias was evaluated using Begg’s funnel plot and the Egger

penalties.item: no conflict-of-interest statement / manufacturer funding of tested product
penalties.evidence_quote: The authors declare that they have no known competing

penalties.note: RCTs only; not applicable to a systematic review

penalties.item: no sample size justification / power analysis
penalties.note: not applicable to a secondary study

penalties.item: follow-up shorter than the outcome plausibly requires
penalties.evidence_quote: a specific methodology and long-term follow-ups
penalties.note: the review's own limitations state long-term follow-ups are necessary; pooled satisfaction measured at 6 weeks in 3 of 4 data points and 6 months in one, while the conclusions present both approaches as viable alternatives

sources.fact_fa: این مقاله در DES امتیاز ۲۷ و باند D (شواهد ضعیف) را در نوع سؤال THERAPY گرفته است.
sources.interpretation_fa: روش‌شناسی review شفاف و ثبت‌شده است، اما meta-analysis چند جفت مقایسه از یک مطالعه را مستقل شمرده و فقط بر ۲ تا ۳ مطالعه با heterogeneity بالا تکیه دارد. follow-up کوتاه است و بیشتر داده‌ها مربوط به فک بالاست. یافته‌ی «تفاوت معنادار نبودن» retention و satisfaction بین denture پرینت‌شده و milled بر تعداد کم مطالعه و heterogeneity بالا استوار است.

citation.title: Clinical Performance and Patients’ Satisfaction of Digitally Versus Conventionally Fabricated Dentures: A Randomized Controlled Pilot Study
citation.authors: Jonas Rechlin, Florian Beuer, Robert Nicic, Rebecca Noetzel, Wolfgang Hannak, Elisabeth Prause

s_design.anchor: RCT, randomized cross-over pilot trial (THERAPY RCT row, 85)
s_design.evidence_quote: This study was designed as a randomized controlled cross-over clinical pilot trial.

domains.evidence_quote: The allocation sequence remained concealed from enrolling clinicians until assignment.
domains.note: computer-generated sequence produced by an independent study nurse; allocation concealed

domains.evidence_quote: interventions were delivered as intended without relevant protocol deviations.
domains.note: patients blinded, clinicians not blinded; one patient could not tolerate the conventional denture, and how this deviation was handled in the analysis is not stated

domains.evidence_quote: unavailable for 2 patients (13.3%) due to non-response.
domains.note: losses stated (2 of 15 OHIP datasets at t2, 12 analysed longitudinally); analysis restricted to available data, and the authors acknowledge possible attrition bias

domains.evidence_quote: examiner blinding was not feasible due to obvious differences between
domains.note: patient-reported OHIP-G49 collected from blinded patients; clinical scores from a single unblinded examiner without calibration

domains.evidence_quote: the study was retrospectively registered in the German Clinical
domains.note: registration made after data collection (2026); a pre-specified protocol and analysis plan are asserted but cannot be checked against a prospective record

penalties.item: no conflict-of-interest statement, or manufacturer funding of a tested product with no independent-analysis statement
penalties.evidence_quote: The sponsor had no role in the study design, data collection, data analysis,
penalties.note: funded by Ivoclar, whose Digital Denture workflow and materials are tested; a CoI statement exists and states the sponsor had no role in design, data collection, analysis or interpretation, so the clause does not fire

penalties.item: clinical trial not prospectively registered (RCTs only)
penalties.evidence_quote: the study was retrospectively registered in the German Clinical

penalties.item: no sample size justification / power analysis
penalties.evidence_quote: No formal a priori sample size or
penalties.note: sample size set pragmatically by patient availability; 5 × 85 ÷ 100 = 4.25 → 4

penalties.item: follow-up shorter than the outcome plausibly requires
penalties.note: stated outcomes are OHRQoL and clinical performance after a three-month adaptation period; the paper makes no survival or durability claim, so the follow-up is not short relative to the claim made

sources.fact_fa: امتیاز DES این مقاله ۴۳ است، در باند C (شواهد محدود) برای سؤال THERAPY.
sources.interpretation_fa: این RCT کراس‌اوور پایلوت با ۱۵ بیمار randomization و allocation concealment مناسبی دارد. در مقابل، ارزیاب بالینی blind نبوده، ثبت کارآزمایی retrospective است، داده‌ی OHIP دو بیمار از دست رفته و power analysis انجام نشده است. تفاوت DCD و CCD معنادار نبود. ارزش بالینی این مطالعه در حد نشان‌دادن نتیجه‌ی کوتاه‌مدت مشابه دو روش است.
